description: Season-aware conference-membership windows per programme (institution_slug x gender), 2016-2026. Authored from official GAC/MIAA, LSC, GSC, GLVC, RMAC, SSC, NE10, CACC, ECC, PSAC, MEC, G-MAC, GLIAC (gliac.org), SAC (the thesac.com standings archive), Conference Carolinas (conferencecarolinas.com), Peach Belt (peachbeltconference.org), CCAA (goccaa.org), PacWest (thepacwest.com) and GNAC (the gnacsports.com standings archive) and NSIC (northernsun.org) records, and for NCAA Division I men's soccer 2022-2026 (25 of the conferences whose conference_profiles carry level d1, the Mid-American Conference for 2022 only) from each conference's own records pages and 2026 standings, each 2022 season also held against the conference's archived 2022 standings (standings.aspx?standings={id}, the id named in the source sentence), the Big East and CAA standings archives for divisions, and the researched pages the season matrix names for the WAC, the 2022 and 2023 Pac-12 and the movers (Wayback captures where the conference's own archive no longer serves the season), and for NCAA Division I women's soccer 2022-2026 (the 31 conferences the NCAA approved for automatic qualification in 2026, all of them d1 profiles, and for 2022-2025 the Western Athletic Conference, the UAC's predecessor, with the Pac-12 for 2022 and 2023 only; the Division I independents by their own schedules) from each conference's own live 2026 women's standings and archived 2022-2025 ones (standings.aspx?standings={id}, the id named in the source sentence), the Southeastern Conference's read from its standings API, and Wayback captures where the conference's own archive no longer serves the season (the Pac-12's 2022 and 2023 tables, the SEC's 2022 and 2023 pages for divisions); each window cites its source. standings_archives names, per conference code, the standings archive a conference with no per-season records pages keeps its member lists in (url_template with {id}, and the page id per season), so a source sentence can cite the page and check-membership --standings can read a captured copy of it back. Sibling in role to the generated canon.json identity map - identity and membership are separate axes (tl-ath plan gate, 2026-08-08).
